also: the road to the stars is through the rough

terms.comment: A modern tag; we have found no ancient source for it. Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase. The nearest ancient line is Seneca’s (below).

evidence: Verg. A. 9.641: macte novā virtūte, puer, sīc ītur ad astra
terms.gloss: that is the way to the stars

terms.latin: Nōn est ad astra mollis ē terrīs via.
terms.comment: Literally “the way from earth to the stars is not soft”: Megara’s answer to the tyrant Lycus.
